title: Drupal core deprecated and removed APIs

latest_stable.description: Newest stable core release the `status` field was computed against.

id.description: Stable unique key: <type>:<symbol> lowercased, or a short slug for curated entries.

symbol.description: The deprecated symbol exactly as it appears in code: function(), \Fully\Qualified\Class, Class::method(), service id, hook_name, library name (module/library), YAML key.

status.description: removed: removed_in is at or before the newest stable release. deprecated: still present.

removed_in.description: Version that removes the symbol, as stated by core.

replacement.description: Replacement guidance, quoted or condensed from the core deprecation message. Empty string when core states none.

source_url.description: Where the entry was verified: the change record when there is one, otherwise the core source file at the tag where the notice appears.

origin.description: core-source: extracted from the @deprecated notice in core. curated: added by hand and checked against a change record.

priority.description: high: an API coding agents are known to still emit.
